active_model.scope: local experimental activation authorized by owner
active_model.threshold_basis: Lowest threshold with >=90% validation selective accuracy on curated/v3 validation (38 photos); test applied once. See docs/part-6-v3-evaluation.json and docs/part-6-identification.md. GEOFLORA_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD overrides it.

latency.target: p95 <= 5000 ms for <= 5 MB photos, one user
latency.scope: Loopback HTTP on the development machine; excludes mobile network and browser rendering.

unsupported_type.message: Use a JPEG, PNG, or WebP plant photo.

not_an_image.message: Choose a valid plant image at least 64 by 64 pixels.

too_small.message: Choose a valid plant image at least 64 by 64 pixels.

oversized.message: Image exceeds the 20 MB upload limit.

missing_file.message: Choose a plant image before identifying it.

signed_out.message: Sign in to identify a plant.

inference_slow.message: Identification took too long. No prediction was made; please try again.

inference_unavailable.message: No trained MobileNetV2 model is installed yet.

inference_garbage.message: The identification service returned an unreadable response. No prediction was made.

inference_crash.message: Identification failed. No prediction was made.

inference_reset.message: The local ML inference service is not reachable. No prediction was made.

inference_unreachable.message: The local ML inference service is not reachable. No prediction was made.

health_unreachable.message: The local ML inference service is not reachable.
